verdict.rationale: Docs show IDV can check ID numbers, phone, address, name/DOB and combine checks conditionally (skipping some verifications like documents based on risk/country), implying some document-free paths exist, but no evidence explicitly names SSN, national registry, or credit-header-only verification flows as a distinct low-friction option. missing for 10: explicit mention of SSN-only or credit-header verification, explicit 'no-doc' database-only workflow example, independent confirmation of doc-free flows in production.
